comment_regular: Oblivion NiTransformInterpolator time-range query. Aggregates first/last timestamps from translation (data count +0x0A, keys +0x24, stride +0x1D), rotation (count +8, keys +0x20, type +0x10, stride +0x1C), and scale (count +0x0C, keys +0x28, stride +0x1E). Rotation type 4 scans three independent scalar-axis subtracks. Returns [0,0] when no authored track contributes.
